price tag = a small label showing how much something costs
loyalty card = a shop card that collects points or gives discounts
gift voucher = a ticket with a value that can be spent in a shop
carrier bag = a bag from a shop, often paper or plastic, for carrying goods
receipt = a piece of paper that proves you paid for goods
instalment = one of several payments for goods bought over time
interest rate = the extra percentage a bank charges or pays on money
overdraft = an arrangement to spend more money than is in your account
contactless = paying by tapping a card or phone without entering a PIN
counterfeit = made as a copy of something valuable in order to deceive
hire purchase = a system of paying in instalments and owning the goods at the end
pay a deposit = to pay a first sum to reserve goods or a service
advance payment = money paid before goods are delivered or work is finished
current account = a bank account for everyday spending and receiving pay
savings account = a bank account for money you do not spend at once
debit card = a card that takes money straight from your bank account
credit limit = the maximum amount you may spend on a credit card
interest-free = with no extra percentage charged if you pay on time
bank charges = fees a bank takes for services or for going into the red
direct debit = an instruction that lets a company take money from your account
